Token Launch Radar

The DefiLlama protocols that still have no token — and are not a wrapped or staked product of a token that already trades — ranked by what their launch would be worth.

Snapshot: 2026-11-25 · 2,291 no-token candidates from 9,110 protocols tracked · Score = TVL + growth + chains + fees + category (breakdown shown per protocol) · No launch is guaranteed; farming steps are positioning, not a promise.

#ProtocolCategoryChains TVL7dFees / 24hScore

How the ranking works

Has a token? A protocol counts as having a token if the snapshot records a token contract address, a CoinGecko id, a CoinMarketCap id, or a market cap. The address is the decisive signal — Aave V3, LayerZero V2, Ethena USDe, Morpho Blue, SparkLend and Sky Lending all carry a token contract while their CoinGecko / market-cap fields are empty.

Excluded: centralised exchanges, bridges and canonical bridges, liquid-staking and staking pools, chains, stablecoins (the product itself is a token), and wrapped / bridged / staked products of an asset that already trades.

Launch Value Score (max ~90): TVL, log-scaled (0–40) + 7d growth, clamped (−4 to +10) + chain count, log-scaled (0–12) + annualised 24h fees, log-scaled (0–16) + a category weight (Prediction Market 12, DEX / Lending / Derivatives 8, Yield / RWA / CDP 5, Risk Curators and capital allocators 0 — their token would be a vault-manager governance token, worth less per dollar of TVL). TVL alone undervalues prediction markets (huge volume, modest TVL) and overvalues vault infrastructure, so fees and category correct for that.

Data: DefiLlama public API, snapshot 2026-11-25 (api.llama.fi/protocols + api.llama.fi/overview/fees). Token launches happen constantly — a protocol listed here may launch after this snapshot; the board is a dated snapshot, not a live feed.
